title: Center Ice Hockey
description:
Center Ice Hockey is a fast, physical ice hockey game with all you'd expect from a proper PC ice hockey title. Charge up a slapshot, lift a saucer pass over a defender's stick, throw a big hit that leaves someone on the ice and drop the gloves to answer the call. Play a quick exhibition, a 32-team season, or create your own player and build a career across decades of seasons with friends on the same team.

Hockey that plays like hockey

A classic, arcady feel, but with real ice hockey rules and gameplay that PC players have missed out on for decades.

A career you can share 

Create a player, assign skill points and if you want, have your friends join your career with their own player and work your way to the top together. Play a good season and you might be selected to play for your national team.

Make it your league 

The game features a full team and player editor which allows you to save and load roster sets from disk.
description_short: Fast, physical ice hockey game. Launch blistering slapshots, saucer passes, hit opponents down on to the ice, then drop your gloves to answer the call. Play exhibition, a full season, or a multi-season career with your friends sharing one team.
